name: logDeriv_eqOn_iff
statement: 𝕜 → 𝕜'} {s : Set 𝕜} (hf : DifferentiableOn 𝕜 f s) (hg : DifferentiableOn 𝕜 g s) (hs2 : IsOpen s) (hsc : IsPreconnected s) (hgn : ∀ x ∈ s, g x ≠ 0) (hfn : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≠ 0) : EqOn (logDeriv f) (logDeriv g) s ↔ ∃ z : 𝕜', z ≠ 0 ∧ EqOn f (z • g) s

have_tree.name: hderiv
have_tree.type: s.EqOn (deriv (f * g⁻¹)) (deriv f * g⁻¹ - f * deriv g / g ^ 2)

name: AnalyticAt.tendsto_mul_logDeriv_simple_zero
statement: 𝕜 → 𝕜} {x : 𝕜} (hf : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f x) (hfx : f x = 0) (hf' : deriv f x ≠ 0) : Filter.Tendsto (fun w => (w - x) * logDeriv f w) (𝓝[≠] x) (𝓝 1)
